# Moretta

> Moretta is a private AI chat on Solana. Users sign in with a Solana wallet, chat with the AI model of their choice, and keep their chat history in the browser. Holders of $MORETTA get a tank of free credit that fills by $1 every hour while they hold at least $10 of $MORETTA, up to $24.

## Docs

- [What is Moretta](what-is-moretta.md): the chat, the models, and the wallet sign-in.
- [The tank](tank.md): the line ($10), the hourly fill ($1), the cap ($24), how the app values a holding, and how the chat spends credit.
- [Privacy](privacy.md): where chat history lives, what the Moretta server keeps, and the Private and Anonymous model labels.
- [The token](token.md): $MORETTA on Solana, on pump.fun, the contract address, and its official sources.
- [FAQ](faq.md): short answers to common questions.
- [Onchain research](onchain-research.md): the AI agent that reads Solana chain data with read-only tools, at most 6 tools for one question. Basics (token info, top holders, market, wallet overview, dev check); scam and rug checks (bundles, snipers, clusters, fresh wallets, dev history, sell test, risky extensions, copycats, socials); smart money (smart wallets, KOL wallets, wallet PnL, top traders); flow (buy and sell flow, wash trading, holder growth, curve progress); and a safety report with green, yellow, and red signals.
- [Payments](payments.md): free credit from the tank, and the next development: private top-ups on Starknet, anonymous vouchers, pay with SOL or ZEC, and private billing.
